title: Everyday verbs 1
about: Verb + noun collocations with make and do, such as make a decision, make friends, do your homework and do the shopping. Make is mostly about producing or creating something, do about carrying out an action or a job.

parts.title: Tip
parts.note: Порада з книжки: шукай у таблицях групи. Make — це передусім «створити, виробити щось» (рішення, зміни, друзів), а do — «виконати дію, роботу» (уроки, вправи, хатні справи). Багато сполучень з make пов'язані з тим, що ми кажемо: make a comment, make an excuse, make a contribution to a discussion. Такі зв'язки допомагають запам'ятати правильне дієслово. І пам'ятай: не кожне «робити» — це make чи do. Фото — take a photo, вечірка — have / throw a party, перерва — have / take a break.

rows: Saying things
make a comment · make an excuse · make a contribution · make a phone call
He made an excuse and left the party early.
Deciding and planning
make a decision · make a choice · make arrangements · make a change
We made our choice and booked the flights.
Getting better
make progress · make an improvement · make an effort
She makes an effort to speak Spanish every day.
People
make friends · do sb a favour · do sb a good turn
Our dog helps us make friends in the park.
Jobs at home
do the shopping / ironing / washing · do your hair
I do the ironing on Sunday evenings.
Study and work
do your homework · do exercises · do an experiment · do some work · do your best
We did an experiment with ice and salt.
Damage
do damage · do harm
Luckily, the storm did no damage.
Not make or do
take a photo · have / throw a party · have / take a break
Let's have a break and take a photo of the view.

items.pattern: make arrangements for sth / sb · make arrangements to do sth · make arrangements for sb to do sth
items.meaning: plan and organise what is needed so that something can happen
items.example: We need to **make arrangements for** someone to feed the cat while we're away.
more: My parents **made all the arrangements for** our wedding, so we didn't have to worry about a thing.
Have you **made any arrangements** to get to the airport?
items.watchOut: «Домовитися, все організувати» — make arrangements, не do arrangements. Зазвичай у множині й з FOR: make arrangements for the trip. Одним дієсловом — arrange: We've arranged to meet at six.

items.pattern: make a change · make (some / a few / big) changes (to sth)
items.meaning: change something, often to make it better
items.example: We've **made a few changes** to the living room: new curtains and a bigger sofa.
more: If you want to sleep better, **make some changes** to your evening routine.
The café **has made changes** to its menu and now serves breakfast all day.
items.watchOut: «Вносити зміни» — make changes, не do changes. Зазвичай changes TO sth: make changes to the plan. It makes a change — «приємна зміна, для різноманітності»: It makes a change to have dinner out.

items.pattern: make a choice (between A and B) · make the right / wrong / difficult choice
items.meaning: decide which one of several things you want
items.example: There were so many cakes that the kids couldn't **make a choice**.
more: You'll have to **make a choice between** the red coat and the blue one. We can't afford both.
I think we **made the right choice** when we moved to the countryside.
items.watchOut: «Зробити вибір» — make a choice, не do a choice. Have a choice — інше: «мати вибір, можливість обирати»: We didn't have a choice.

items.pattern: make a comment / comments (on / about sth) · make a rude / helpful / positive comment
items.meaning: say what you think about something
items.example: My aunt always **makes comments about** what I'm wearing.
more: The teacher **made some helpful comments on** my essay.
Please don't **make any comments** about his new haircut. He's upset about it.
items.watchOut: «Прокоментувати, зробити зауваження» — make a comment, не do a comment і не say a comment. Про що — ON або ABOUT: comments on my work. Make a remark — те саме.

items.pattern: make a (big / useful / small) contribution to sth
items.meaning: give money, help or ideas to help something succeed
items.example: Everyone in our street **made a contribution to** the summer party: food, music or chairs.
more: My grandad **made a big contribution to** the village football club over the years.
The kids next door **made a great contribution to** the street clean-up: they filled three bags with rubbish.
items.watchOut: «Зробити внесок» — make a contribution, не do a contribution. Внесок У щось — зазвичай contribution TO sth: a contribution to the party.

items.pattern: make a decision (about / on sth) · make a decision to do sth · make the decision
items.meaning: decide something after thinking about it
items.example: We **made the decision** to sell the car and cycle to work instead.
more: Don't **make a decision** now. Sleep on it and tell me tomorrow.
My sister finds it hard to **make decisions**, even in a restaurant.
items.watchOut: «Прийняти рішення» — make a decision, не accept a decision: accept a decision — це «погодитися з чужим рішенням». Британці кажуть і take a decision, тож take тут не помилка. А do a decision — помилка.

items.pattern: make an effort (to do sth) · make an effort with sth / sb · make a real / big / special effort · make the effort
items.meaning: try hard to do something
items.example: I'm **making an effort** to drink more water and less coffee.
more: Dad **made a special effort** and cooked a three-course dinner for Mum's birthday.
You should **make more of an effort** with your new neighbours. At least say hello.
items.watchOut: «Докласти зусиль» — make an effort, не do an effort і не apply efforts. Зазвичай в однині: make an effort. Ще кажуть put (a lot of) effort into sth: She put a lot of effort into the garden.

items.pattern: make an excuse (for sth / for doing sth) · make excuses · make your excuses (= apologise and leave)
items.meaning: give a reason, often not the true one, for why you can't or didn't do something
items.example: Every time we ask him to help with the move, he **makes an excuse**.
more: Stop **making excuses** and tidy your room.
I didn't want to go to the meeting, so I **made an excuse** about a dentist appointment.
items.watchOut: «Вигадати відмовку, виправдовуватися» — make an excuse / make excuses, не do an excuse. Give an excuse і find an excuse теж природні. Іменник excuse закінчується на /s/, а дієслово excuse (Excuse me) — на /z/.

items.pattern: make friends (with sb) · make new friends · make a new friend
items.meaning: start a friendship with someone
items.example: Our son **made friends with** a boy from the flat upstairs on his first day.
more: It's easier to **make friends** when you join a club or a team.
My mum **made lots of new friends** at her dance class.
items.watchOut: «Заводити друзів» — make friends, не do friends і не get friends. Подружитися з кимось — make friends WITH sb, і friends тут у множині, навіть про одну людину: I made friends with Anna. Ще кажуть become friends: We became friends at school.

items.pattern: make an improvement · make improvements (to sth) · make a big / real / huge improvement
items.meaning: make something better; (of a change) make a situation better
items.example: A new mattress has **made a huge improvement** to my sleep.
more: The school is **making improvements to** the playground this summer.
Your handwriting is much neater. You've **made a big improvement**.
items.watchOut: «Покращити, внести покращення» — make improvements, не do improvements. Покращення чогось — improvements TO sth: improvements to the kitchen. Помітити покращення — see / notice an improvement.

items.pattern: make a mistake (in / with sth) · make a big / silly / terrible mistake · make the mistake of doing sth
items.meaning: do or say something wrong
items.example: I **made a mistake** and got on the wrong train.
more: Don't worry, everyone **makes mistakes** when they're learning to drive.
We **made the mistake of** going to the beach on a bank holiday.
items.watchOut: «Зробити помилку» — make a mistake, не do a mistake і не allow a mistake (калька з «допустити помилку»). Помилка В ЧОМУСЬ — a mistake IN sth: a mistake in the bill.

items.pattern: make a (phone) call (to sb) · make a quick call · make some phone calls
items.meaning: phone someone
items.example: Sorry, I'll be five minutes. I just need to **make a phone call**.
more: My grandma **makes a phone call** to each of her grandchildren every Sunday.
I spent the whole morning **making phone calls** about the broken boiler.
items.watchOut: «Подзвонити» — make a phone call або просто call / phone / ring sb, не do a call. Take a call — інше: «відповісти на дзвінок». Give sb a call — розмовне «набрати когось».

items.pattern: make progress (with / in sth) · make good / slow / real progress
items.meaning: get better at something, or move closer to finishing it
items.example: My dad is **making good progress** after his knee operation.
more: Are you **making any progress with** your driving lessons?
We're **making progress** with the garden: the weeds are finally gone.
items.watchOut: Progress — незлічуване: make progress, a lot of progress, не a progress і не progresses. «Мати прогрес» — не have progress, а make progress.

items.pattern: do my / your / her best (to do sth)
items.meaning: try as hard as you can
items.uk: зробити все можливе, старатися з усіх сил
items.example: I can't promise we'll win, but we'll **do our best**.
more: The cake isn't perfect, but I **did my best**.
The nurses **did their best** to make Grandad comfortable.
items.watchOut: «Зробити все можливе» — do your best, не make your best. Займенник обов'язковий і відповідає підмету: I do my best, she does her best. Try your best теж природно.

items.pattern: do (some / a lot of / serious) damage (to sth)
items.meaning: harm or break something
items.example: The frost **did a lot of damage to** our tomato plants.
more: Luckily, the flood didn't **do much damage** to the house.
Too much sun can **do serious damage to** your skin.
items.watchOut: «Завдати шкоди» — do damage або cause damage, не make damage. Damage тут незлічуване: a lot of damage, не damages (damages — гроші, які суд присуджує як компенсацію). Вимова: /ˈdæmɪdʒ/, не «деймідж».

items.pattern: do an experiment (on / with sth) · do experiments
items.meaning: carry out a scientific test to find something out
items.example: At school we **did an experiment** to see which paper towel soaks up the most water.
more: My kids love **doing experiments** in the kitchen with vinegar and baking soda.
Scientists **did experiments** on mice to test the new medicine.
items.watchOut: «Проводити експеримент» — do an experiment, офіційніше carry out / conduct an experiment. Не hold an experiment (калька з «проводити»). Lead an experiment — «керувати експериментом, бути головним», а не просто «проводити». Make an experiment сьогодні звучить застаріло.

items.pattern: do exercises · do (some) stretching / breathing / grammar exercises · do exercise (uncountable: physical activity)
items.meaning: do a set of movements to train your body, or tasks to practise what you are learning
items.example: My physio told me to **do these exercises** for my back every morning.
more: Before the test, we **did some listening exercises** in class.
I try to **do some breathing exercises** when I feel stressed.
items.watchOut: «Робити вправи, зарядку» — do exercises, не make exercises. Про фізичну активність загалом — do / get / take exercise, без a і без -s: I don't do enough exercise.

items.pattern: do sb a favour · do sb a big favour · ask sb a favour · owe sb a favour · do yourself a favour
items.meaning: help someone because they ask you to
items.example: Can you **do me a favour**? Keep an eye on my bag while I buy a coffee.
more: My neighbour **did me a big favour** and drove me to the station at five in the morning.
**Do yourself a favour** and go to bed early before the exam.
items.watchOut: «Зробити послугу» — do sb a favour, не make sb a favour. Попросити про послугу — ask sb a favour. Британське написання — favour, американське — favor.

items.pattern: do sb a good turn · One good turn deserves another.
items.meaning: do something kind or helpful for someone
items.example: A stranger **did me a good turn** when he found my wallet and posted it back to me.
more: Our neighbours fed our cat all summer, so we **did them a good turn** and cut their hedge.
Try to **do someone a good turn** every day, even if it's just holding a door open.
items.watchOut: Do sb a good turn трохи старомодніше за do sb a favour і частіше про добру справу, про яку не просили. Не make sb a good turn. Turn тут — «вчинок», а не «поворот».

items.pattern: do harm (to sb / sth) · do sb (no / any) harm · do more harm than good
items.meaning: hurt or damage someone or something
items.example: A little chocolate now and then won't **do you any harm**.
more: Shouting at the kids will **do more harm than good**.
It **does no harm** to ask. The worst they can say is no.
items.watchOut: «Зашкодити» — do harm або cause harm, не make harm. Порядок слів: do sb harm (It won't do you any harm) або do harm to sb. Harm — незлічуване, без a.

items.pattern: do my / your / her hair · have / get your hair done (at the hairdresser's)
items.meaning: wash, brush or style your hair so that it looks nice
items.example: Give me ten minutes. I just need to **do my hair**.
more: My daughter likes to **do her own hair** for school now.
She spent an hour **doing her hair** for the wedding.
items.watchOut: «Зробити зачіску» — do your hair, не make your hair і не make a hairstyle. Якщо зачіску робить перукар — have / get your hair done: I'm having my hair done on Friday.

items.pattern: do my / your homework · do some homework
items.meaning: do the work a teacher gives you to do at home
items.example: Our daughter **does her homework** at the kitchen table while I cook.
more: My son needs my help when he **does his maths homework**.
I never **did my homework** on Fridays. I always left it until Sunday night.
items.watchOut: «Робити уроки, домашку» — do your homework, не make homework. Homework — незлічуване: a lot of homework, не homeworks. Не плутай з housework — хатня робота.

items.pattern: do the ironing / shopping / washing / cooking / cleaning / washing-up
items.meaning: do regular jobs in the house
items.uk: прасувати / ходити по продукти / прати / готувати / прибирати
items.example: On Saturdays I **do the shopping** while the kids are at football.
more: Can you **do the ironing**? I've got nothing to wear tomorrow.
My grandad still **does all the washing** by hand.
items.watchOut: Хатні справи — do the + -ing: do the shopping, не make the shopping. Do the washing — прати білизну, а do the washing-up — мити посуд. Go shopping (без the) — ходити по магазинах, часто для задоволення.

items.pattern: do (some / a lot of / no) work (on sth)
items.meaning: spend time working on something
items.example: I'm going to **do some work** in the garden while it's dry.
more: We need to **do some work on** the house before we sell it.
I didn't **do any work** at the weekend. I just slept.
items.watchOut: «Попрацювати» — do some work, не make some work. Make work (for sb) — інше: «додавати (зайвої) роботи»: The dog makes a lot of work for us. Work тут незлічуване: some work, не a work.

warmup.uk: Вибач, я помилився: зустріч завтра, а не сьогодні.
warmup.q: Sorry, I ___ a mistake: the meeting is tomorrow, not today.
warmup.explain: Зробити помилку — make a mistake. Do a mistake і allow a mistake («допустити помилку») — кальки.

warmup.uk: Діти роблять уроки у своїй кімнаті.
warmup.q: The kids are ___ their homework in their room.
warmup.explain: Робити уроки — do your homework. Make homework — типова помилка.

warmup.uk: Нам треба ухвалити рішення до п'ятниці.
warmup.q: We need to ___ a decision by Friday.
warmup.explain: Прийняти (ухвалити) рішення — make a decision (британці кажуть і take). Accept a decision — погодитися з чужим рішенням.

warmup.uk: Зроби мені послугу — полий квіти, поки мене не буде.
warmup.q: ___ me a favour and water the plants while I'm away.
warmup.explain: Зробити послугу — do sb a favour, не make.

warmup.q: Who ___ the cooking in your house?
warmup.explain: Хатні справи — do the cooking / shopping / ironing / washing.

warmup.uk: Вона робить великі успіхи в англійській.
warmup.q: She's ___ great progress with her English.
warmup.explain: Робити успіхи — make progress. Progress незлічуване, без a.

warmup.uk: Буря завдала великої шкоди нашому саду.
warmup.q: The storm ___ a lot of damage to our garden.
warmup.explain: Завдати шкоди — do damage (або cause damage), не make.

A.q: My daughter has to ___ a choice between art and music next year.
A.explain: Зробити вибір — make a choice. Do / take a choice — помилка.

A.q: I'm sorry I ___ such a silly mistake with your name.
A.explain: Помилитися — make a mistake, не do a mistake.

A.q: Grandma is ___ an effort to walk a little further every day.
A.explain: Докладати зусиль — make an effort. Put теж буває, але в іншій конструкції: put a lot of effort into sth.

B.q: She was nervous before the interview, but she ___ her best.
B.explain: Зробити все можливе — do your best, не make your best.

B.q: Using too much fertiliser can ___ harm to your plants.
B.explain: Зашкодити — do harm (to sth) або cause harm, не make harm.

B.q: My flatmate never ___ the cleaning, so the bathroom is always dirty.
B.explain: Хатні справи — do the cleaning / shopping / ironing.

example.title: A new start
example.uk:
Минулої весни ми переїхали в маленьке містечко в Англії, і це було непросто. Нам довелося багато чого змінити. Ми з чоловіком ухвалили рішення розділити хатні справи: я ходжу по продукти, а він готує.

Нашому синові було важко заводити друзів у новій школі. Він робив усе можливе, але тижнями приходив додому сумний. Та одного дня наша сусідка зробила нам велику послугу: вона запросила його на день народження свого онука.

Тепер він робить добрі успіхи в англійській і навіть робить домашнє завдання без нарікань. Я помилялася, коли думала, що ми ніколи не почуватимемося тут як удома. Цього тижня ми організовуємо все для вечірки в саду, на яку запросимо всіх сусідів.
example.en:
Last spring we moved to a small town in England, and it wasn't easy. We had to [[make a lot of changes|a2]]. My husband and I [[made a decision|a6]] to share the jobs at home: I [[do the shopping|b10]], and he cooks.

Our son found it hard to [[make friends|a9]] at his new school. He [[did his best|b1]], but for weeks he came home sad. Then one day our neighbour [[did us a big favour|b5]]: she invited him to her grandson's birthday party.

Now he's [[making good progress|a13]] with his English, and he even [[does his homework|b9]] without complaining. I [[made a mistake|a11]] when I thought we'd never feel at home here. This week we're [[making arrangements|a1]] for a garden party for all our neighbours.
